loiGiai: \begin{center} \end{center} Ta có $BA'=\sqrt{6}\Rightarrow AA'=\sqrt{BA'^2-AB^2}=\sqrt{\left(\sqrt{6}\right)^2-\left(\sqrt{2}\right)^2}=2$.\\ Gắn hệ trục tọa độ như hình vẽ ta có\\ $A(0;0;0)$, $C(\sqrt{2};0;0)$, $A'(0;0;2)$, $B\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2};\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{2};0\right)$, $B'\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2};\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{2};2\right)$.\\ Ta có $\overrightarrow{A'B}=\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2};\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{2};-2\right)$, $\overrightarrow{B'C}=\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2},-\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{2},-2\right)$, $\overrightarrow{A'B'}=\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{2},0\right)$.\\ Suy ra$\left[\overrightarrow{A'B},\overrightarrow{B'C}\right]=(-2\sqrt{6},0,-\sqrt{3})$.\\ Vậy $\mathrm{d}\left(A'B,B'C\right)=\dfrac{\left|\left[\overrightarrow{A'B},\overrightarrow{B'C}\right]\cdot \overrightarrow{A'B'}\right|}{\left|\left[\overrightarrow{A'B},\overrightarrow{B'C}\right]\right|}=\dfrac{\left|2\sqrt{6}\cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right|}{\sqrt{(2\sqrt{6})^2+(\sqrt{3})^2}}=\dfrac{2}{3}\approx 0{,}67$.
